down-regulation by symbiont of host inflammatory response
downregulation by symbiont of host inflammatory response
negative regulation by symbiont of host inflammatory response
suppression by symbiont of host inflammatory response
broad: negative regulation by organism of inflammatory response of other organism involved in symbiotic interaction
narrow: inhibition by symbiont of host inflammatory response

definition: A process in which a symbiont inhibits or disrupts the normal execution of  inflammatory response in the host organism; the inflammatory response is the immediate defensive reaction (by vertebrate tissue) to infection or injury caused by chemical or physical agents. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated suppression of host inflammatory response
